_about: Pipeline site list. Fields id, name, lat, lon, description, psr_distance_km and nasa_avg_illumination_pct follow docs/CONTRATO_DE_DADOS.md (sites.json). The other fields record provenance. Coordinates are regional reference points, NOT NASA-designated landing sites. lat/lon: degrees, MOON_ME (DE421 mean Earth/polar axis), east-positive longitude in [-180, 180).

sites.name: Shackleton rim
sites.description: Regional reference point: the pixel with the highest NASA average solar illumination (LOLA 60 m map) inside the NASA region 'Shackleton rim' (Site04). Not a NASA-designated landing site.

source.document: Derived by this project (docs/DECISOES.md D30). Region: PGDA product 78 tile Site04; published centre: NASA M2M-30044 Moon to Mars Lunar Surface Data Book (2025), Table A2.1-1, page 75; illumination: PGDA product 69 AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608 (60 m).
source.location: Rule: inside the region, the pixel with the highest NASA average solar illumination; ties: nearest to the published centre (python -m pipeline.sites.derive_illumination_points)

sites.cross_check: 2752 m from the published centre; NASA average illumination 87.06% at the point; 1 pixel(s) shared the maximum.

sites.name: Shackleton inner wall (Site04 center)
sites.description: Published centre of the LOLA 5 m DEM region 'Shackleton Rim' (Site04). It lies on the crater's inner wall (~31 deg slope), so it is kept only to show how sensitive light and Earth visibility are to the exact position. Not a NASA-designated landing site.

source.document: NASA M2M-30044 Moon to Mars Lunar Surface Data Book, Baseline, effective 2025-03-18 (NASA/TP-20250002845)
source.location: Appendix A2.1, Table A2.1-1 Lunar South Pole Features, page 75 of 93

sites.cross_check: Matches the centre of PGDA product 78 Site04_final_adj_5mpp_surf.tif (pipeline/sites/verify_site_points.py).
